newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank shares placed by JP Morgan.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank shares placed by JP Morgan.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Swedbank said on Friday JP Morgan & Co had placed 5.3 million of its shares, or about 1.9 percent of the bank, with institutional investors this week.

"In 1993, at the time of the recapitalisation of Swedbank, JP Morgan acquired 5.3 million shares of Swedbank, equivalent to approximately 1.9 percent of shares outstanding of the bank," Swedbank said in a statement.

"In accordance with the original agreement between Swedbank and JP Morgan, these shares have, during the week been placed with new institutional investors," said Swedbank, which is known in Sweden as Sparbanken Sverige AB.
